Lower Text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon may unsuspend.
Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
